title: 1975 Before the train station was torn down
description: July 28, 1877, Carleton Sentinel: “From our window, we can see the train moving from Hartland. We see the white steam rising, and we catch the sound of the whistle. Such things, progressive things, not like when our fathers polled their canoes from Fredericton to bring supplies for our families. We are living in a progressive age. What will 50 years bring?” The photo shows the original train station in the 1800s, with warehouses owned by local tradesmen. (Photo courtesy of Buddy Barss)
